allow: PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\('C:\\Diploma\\Messenger.zip'\); $names = $zip.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; '--- Total entries: ' + $names.Count; '--- Key files present? ---'; foreach \($f in @\('README.md','Messenger.sln','Messenger.Server/messenger.db','Messenger.Server/Program.cs','Messenger.Client/MainWindow.xaml','Messenger.Shared/Models/User.cs'\)\) { $hit = $names -contains $f; \('{0,-45} {1}' -f $f, $\(if\($hit\){'OK'}else{'MISSING'}\)\) }; '--- Any bin/obj/.vs leaked in? ---'; \($names | Where-Object { $_ -match '\(^|/\)\(bin|obj\)/' -or $_ -match '\\.vs/' }\).Count; $zip.Dispose\(\))
